doubles.state: Read/Write-LocalCoreState use fresh synthetic JSON files, DateKind String detached objects, and an explicit simulated revision/write-id conflict check. Write rejection and write race are injected. This is NOT actual durable-store, filesystem lock, atomic replacement, recovery, multi-process concurrency or app restart evidence. Commit-then-throw is an explicit synthetic uncertain-outcome injection, not actual store verification failure.
doubles.UI: Controls are plain objects. Actual Update-AcceptanceControls and Domain dispatch execute; Confirm dequeues explicit answers and optional mutations. Set-PublicationDirty and listing/status rendering use bounded seams. Actual WPF events, modal dispatch, controls, screenshots and full app reload are NOT tested. Postcommit button ScriptProperty setter failure is injected; refreshed stage filtering is a counter.
doubles.rendering: Format-LocalCheck returns a label/state string; Load-LocalPublicationUi and Update-LocalCoreStatusUi are counters. Actual local variant projection, review history event projection, and post-withdrawal readiness early rejection execute. Listing refresh, later ready-path helpers, actual PNG and ZIP verification are NOT covered.
doubles.artifacts: Seeded artwork/archive files contain ordinary synthetic sentinel bytes, not verified PNG/ZIP packages. Tests compare exact bytes and retained metadata; they do NOT establish package or publication receipt authority.
doubles.external: Unexpected server API, concept load, generation job synchronization/dispatch, check automation/export, reapproval, process/network/IO command boundaries throw and are counted globally. These guards are not OS isolation; use the existing private-staging + owned-process supervisor. Module initializers are not executed.
